title: E2E: SMTP List-ID article is local-only; sieve article peers
description:
End-to-end test through the full SMTP→reader pipeline verifying provenance routing.

What: crates/integration-tests/tests/injection_provenance_e2e.rs (or extend two_process_harness.rs)

Test 1 — listid_stays_local:
1. Start reader with SMTP relay queue draining.
2. Inject SMTP message via the SMTP session with only a List-ID header (no Newsgroups: header, no sieve script).
3. The fallback router sets SmtpListId source.
4. Drain the NntpQueue.
5. Assert via NNTP GROUP + OVER: article is readable in the newsgroup derived from List-ID.
6. Assert via group log query: zero entries for this article CID (would not be sent via IHAVE).

Test 2 — sieve_route_peers:
1. Upload sieve script: require ["fileinto"]; fileinto "newsgroup:comp.test";
2. Inject SMTP message (no List-ID header; sieve fires).
3. Source is SmtpSieve.
4. Assert via NNTP: article readable in comp.test.
5. Assert via group log: one entry present for this article CID.

Test 3 — newsgroups_header_peers:
1. Inject SMTP message with Newsgroups: comp.test header (no sieve script, no List-ID).
2. Source is SmtpNewsgroups.
3. Assert group log entry present.
